beats.cue: “All three Discord vars named, then exit 2 — before it opens a socket.”

beats.command: env -u DISCORD_APPLICATION_ID -u DISCORD_BOT_TOKEN -u DISCORD_PUBLIC_KEY -u ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN -u ANTHROPIC_API_KEY bun live/dist/daemon.ts

verify.note: designed refusal — `[daemon] missing required env vars: DISCORD_APPLICATION_ID, DISCORD_BOT_TOKEN, DISCORD_PUBLIC_KEY, ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN or ANTHROPIC_API_KEY`; env -u scrubs what Setup sourced

beats.label: Give the interactions endpoint a public URL
beats.cue: [manual] The recipe's `ngrok http 3000` — then paste the tunnel plus /discord/events into the portal's Interactions tab. Discord PINGs it, the adapter PONGs, and the portal saves.
beats.script: This is an operator-controlled step: “Give the interactions endpoint a public URL.” It depends on external state that the offline walkthrough cannot safely supply. [[pause:1.5s]] The recipe's `ngrok http 3000` — then paste the tunnel plus /discord/events into the portal's Interactions tab. Discord PINGs it, the adapter PONGs, and the portal saves.

verify.note: needs ngrok (or any tunnel) and a second terminal; the interactions URL itself is pasted by hand in Discord's Developer Portal, and it only saves if a live PING gets a PONG
